description:
Planning only: start implementation only after the Mattermost prerequisite gate passes and implementation is authorized. Read parent epic and linked Page. Follow AGENTS.md, docs/agent-tools.md, WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, exec-plans/PLAN_STRATEGY.md, action-reuse.md, documentation.md, testing-approach.md and services/channels.md. Read affected service/config/UI policies before work. Recheck module docs, source and existing tests; test scenarios below are specified before implementation. Obtain required approval for changes to existing test behavior; prior UX approval does not cover the new SMTP inputs. Reuse fixtures and internal production boundaries, mock external provider edges only. No automatic application commit/push/merge authorization.

Source mapping: Page Task 3 Add SMTP settings and requirements.

**Files:** `lib/zaq/system/email_config.ex`, `lib/zaq/engine/email_connector_settings.ex`, `lib/zaq/connector_config/smtp_settings.ex`, `lib/zaq/channels/email_bridge.ex`, and `lib/zaq_web/live/bo/communication/notification_smtp_live.html.heex`. Touch its LiveView only when required for existing form bindings.

**Work:** persist and round-trip the two explicit SMTP limits through current channel settings. Add existing design-system form controls and explain encoded size. Keep configuration changes on the existing BO Event/NodeRouter route. Preserve SMTP selection, IMAP binding, password encryption, and the existing failure switch. No database migration is expected if settings remain in the existing settings map.

**Tests:** extend `test/zaq/system/email_config_test.exs`, `test/zaq/engine/email_connector_settings_api_test.exs`, `test/zaq_web/live/bo/communication/notification_smtp_live_test.exs`, and relevant `test/zaq/connector_config/settings_test.exs` cases.

**Paths:** blank, zero, negative, malformed, valid bounds, exact MB-to-byte conversion, selected connector versus default, saved/reopened values, legacy missing settings, unchanged text-only behavior.

**Reuse:** extend existing settings changesets and Engine settings API; no separate configuration store or new credential path. Runtime errors return the shared requirements error and use the same policy.

**Mocking and docs:** reuse existing LiveView/Engine fixtures; no live Gmail needed. Update channels guide and existing module docs. Follow DESIGN.md and BO component rules; new feature E2E remains gated on completed UX approval.

Exactly two new inputs: positive maximum encoded message MB (1,000,000 bytes per MB) and positive maximum attachments per email. Preserve missing legacy values; no guessed provider defaults. Existing send_on_file_failure switch remains. Ordinary text-only delivery bypasses these requirements. Read DESIGN.md, docs/bo-components.md and services/system-config.md before affected edits.

Reuse/verification: use the existing owner and tests named above; no parallel transport pipeline, new history store, automatic Action/tool exposure or Agent-selection changes. Scope any new scheduler unit suite to genuinely distinct invariants.
title: [zaq-1lw.3] Add explicit SMTP message-size and attachment-count settings
